title: Shiraishi An — Happy Birthday!〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Kamiyama High School - Class 1-A

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Morning!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, there you are.
Morning, An.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What?! Mizuki?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Heh heh heh. The look on your face is priceless.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, I mean, you're hardly ever at school bright and early.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, does this mean you have supplementary classes?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Ugh... Please don't remind me...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What if I told you that the reason I'm here is to celebrate your birthday, An?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, yeah, thanks.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Aww... I thought you'd be a little happier than that.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That smug look on your face isn't helping...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But I do appreciate the fact that you're here to celebrate in person even after messaging me right when the clock struck midnight.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Well, I kinda owe you a lot after the School Festival and Sports Festival, you know...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So, once more...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Here you are, An!
Happy birthday♪

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Thanks, Mizuki!
And this box. The wrapping paper feels so nice.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, good eye. Thanks for noticing.
I made sure to choose something nice from my stock!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
You did?
I really don't want to tear it since the pattern on it's so cute...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Ah, you're in luck!
I used masking tape, so you should be able to open it without tearing it.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Now that's what I call service!
Whoa, you're right! It didn't tear at all!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, mind if I keep going to see what's inside?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Of course.
I can't wait to see how you react to it, An.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Alright, without further ado!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, a ponytail holder!
Nice! It looks really cool too!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Doesn't it? I thought that the blue and silver design would suit you really well!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I know you don't usually tie up your hair or anything, but why not try giving something like these a try every so often?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Also, I have a feeling Kohane and some others are gonna be pretty excited to see you with it on. She'll be all, “An, you look so much more mature compared to normal!”

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha! Yeah, totally!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Thanks, Mizuki!
I'll try using them sometime!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Great!
And don't forget to tell me all about how Kohane reacts♪

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Pardon the intrusion.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh? Rui?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
And Tenma...
Are you guys here for Mizuki?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: No, Shiraishi, we're here to see you.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait, me?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, that's right. We heard that it's your birthday today, so we brought you a present to celebrate!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And in my case, you were a huge help during the Sports Festival.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What? But we were the ones who asked you to direct for the cheer squad, so I feel like we owe you a lot more...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
For now, let's set aside those details.
Would you mind taking this present off our hands?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yes, of course.
Thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
By the way, what's in this box?
It's not very big, but it feels pretty heavy...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. That's for you to find out when you open it.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Toya said that you'd all be celebrating as a team, so why not open it then?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I was wondering why they knew when my birthday was, but it was Toya who told them...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Shiraishi, we look forward to working with you as we safely carry out tests and experiments in the future.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Safely?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehehe. Now then...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It can't be easy being a hall monitor having someone like him around.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: If you genuinely feel that way, you could try stopping him.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: My life would be so much easier if I could!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha! You're so quick to admit it!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Anyway, happy birthday!
I hope you and your team get to enjoy a wonderful birthday party!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Thank you! I'm sure we will!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I really wasn't expecting even them to wish me a happy birthday like this.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But I guess they sort of get that they've been causing you a bit of trouble...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: If they understand that, then I really wish they'd just stop...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Still, what could be inside the box that Kamishiro gave me?)
After school

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Bye, Mizuki.
Good luck with supplementary classes!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Okay, bye.
Have fun during your birthday party, An!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Thanks, I will!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay, before I head back to Dad's place...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hm? You on your way over too?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, perfect!
There's something I need to relay to you.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Sure, what?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kohane's on her way over here, so we're gonna meet up and head there together.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Okay, we'll let Ken know.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Great, thanks!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, see you there.
Kamiyama High School - School Gate

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kohane should be here soon...

rows.Speaker: Kohane's Voice
rows.Line: An!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, Kohane...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: An!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hello!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Whaaat?!
